channel.title: Nordic Crypto
channel.description: Actualités bitcoin, blockchain et crypto de Norvège, de Suède, du Danemark, de Finlande et d’Islande, avec des résumés en français, un agenda d’événements et un qui est qui.

item.title: Innrømmer «litt» kryptoutvinning
item.description: Data-centre company Arctic Core says in writing that its business uses crypto mining to generate income during a test phase, but argues this does not change the basic character of the warehouse building it has been granted a permit for, the local paper Ságat reports.

item.title: 30 nya namn på varningslistan – akta dig för företagen
item.description: Sweden's Finansinspektionen has warned against 30 more firms that look legitimate but lack a licence; several lure consumers with trading in shares, crypto and currencies, and some are clone firms using details of real financial companies. FI has now warned against 227 suspected investment-fraud operators so far in 2026 and urges people to check its company register before sending money.

item.title: Amla föreslår tre tekniska standarder enligt penningtvättsförordningen
item.description: The EU anti-money-laundering authority AMLA has sent three final draft technical standards under the new AML regulation to the European Commission, Sweden's Finansinspektionen reports; they still need the Commission's adoption. Under AMLA's report, crypto-asset service providers must consider whether a customer has made three or more transactions in 12 months when deciding if there is a business relationship, use a one-month window for linked transactions, and keep the €1,000 threshold for occasional transactions.

item.title: Småsparere hamstret krypto under renteuro
item.description: Customers of Norwegian exchange Firi bought 16.1 million kroner more crypto than they sold in September, on trading of 313.5 million kroner, despite a turbulent month. Bitcoin was the top buy while many moved money out of XRP into bitcoin and solana; CEO Thuc Hoang sees rising US interest rates as the main risk.

item.title: Ace Digital tjente 6,3 millioner kroner i tredje kvartal
item.description: Ace Digital, listed on Euronext Growth Oslo, reported an unaudited third-quarter net profit of NOK 6.32 million, with equity up 19.3% to NOK 39.09 million and debt reduced to zero. The company says the value of its bitcoin treasury rose 373% without buying bitcoin, and estimates its economic exposure at about 57 BTC.

item.title: Representantforslag om konsesjonssystem for etablering av datasentre
item.description: Socialist Left Party (SV) MPs have proposed in the Storting a «panic law» that would put new data centres on hold until the industry is regulated, plus a national licensing system for data centres. They also ask the government to report back quickly on how the Storting's decision to ban crypto mining in Norway will be followed up; this is a proposal, not a decision.

item.title: Rødt foreslår midlertidig stans for nye datasentre
item.description: The Red Party (Rødt) has proposed in the Storting a temporary halt for new data centres, along with a licensing regime and other measures. Its reasoning says crypto-mining data centres get power ahead of key local industries and that the crypto-mining ban the Storting has asked for three times in two years is still not in place, though none of the proposals singles out crypto.

item.title: Så kan Sverige användas för att finansiera kärnvapen
item.description: Sweden's financial watchdog says crypto-assets and illegal financial networks pose the biggest risk of Iran and North Korea dodging sanctions via Sweden.

item.title: Uppgifter: Tonåringar silvertejpade man i jakt på kryptovaluta
item.description: Three teenagers have been arrested in Lund on suspicion of kidnapping after allegedly tying up a local man with duct tape to rob him of crypto.

item.title: Tiltalt for dopsalg mot kryptovaluta på det mørke nettet
item.description: Three Norwegians and a Swede have been charged in a large drug case with links abroad, involving drug sales for cryptocurrency on the dark web, according to the Southern Norway public prosecutor.

item.title: Kryptojätten i ny kontrovers – erbjöd tjänster i Europa utan licens
item.description: Binance is under investigation for allegedly offering services in Europe without the licence required under the EU's new crypto rules.

item.title: Krypto-jätten rundar reglerna i Europa: Riskerar att kastas ut
item.description: Binance said it would leave Europe, but customers are still trading, and EU financial authorities now want to know how.

item.title: Här är riskerna för finansiering av spridning av massförstörelsevapen störst
item.description: Finansinspektionen's new risk assessment finds that financing of weapons of mass destruction is most likely through illegal financial activity and crypto-assets.

item.title: GreenMerc kutter 4,8 millioner i året – Northcrypto går med overskudd
item.description: GreenMerc is cutting costs by SEK 4.8 million a year while Northcrypto turns a profit, with spending redirected to the banking offer Trijo One.

item.title: Pangstart for nytt kryptofond
item.description: Joakim Hannisdahl's new crypto fund, built on a model that did well in backtesting, is up 39 percent since it launched in August.

item.title: Yhteisöllisyys ja teknologia kiehtovat kryptovaluuttoihin sijoittaneita – kryptotapahtumassa iloittiin bitcoinin uudesta nousurallista
item.description: At a Finnish crypto event, investors described community and technology as what draws them to crypto, as bitcoin rallied again.

item.title: Fant hemmelig passord: Låste opp krypto-lommeboken
item.description: Police have unlocked the crypto wallet of an NHH student charged in a drug case, uncovering assets worth several hundred thousand kroner.

item.title: Safello åpner for at andre selskaper kan tilby kryptokjøp
item.description: Sweden's Safello is testing a setup that lets companies without their own crypto business offer crypto purchases under Safello's MiCA licence.

item.title: Coinmotion og K33 inngår nordisk kryptosamarbeid om institusjonell handel
item.description: Finnish broker Coinmotion has picked Norway's K33 to execute large trades, a partnership between two MiCA-licensed Nordic firms.

item.title: Skal ha stjålet fra egen bedrift – brukte pengene på krypto
item.description: A Norwegian man has been charged with gross embezzlement from his own company and is said to have spent the money on crypto.

item.title: NBX inngår avtale med Tieto om betalingskort for stablecoins
item.description: NBX has signed with Tieto Banktech for a payment card that lets customers spend stablecoins in everyday purchases.

item.title: Minister i nyt skatteopgør: Vil gøre op med »junglen af urimelige og uforståelige regler«
item.description: A review of almost 1,000 Danish crypto tax cases found errors in 23, including one person who overpaid more than DKK 1 million, prompting tax minister Jakob Engel-Schmidt to promise simpler rules.

item.title: Danske Bank: Ingen bank kan bygge euro-stablecoin alene
item.description: Danske Bank says no single bank can build a euro stablecoin on its own and that European banks should build a dollar alternative together through Qivalis.

item.title: Danskere svindlet for 89 millioner kroner på seks måneder
item.description: Danes lost DKK 89 million to investment fraud in the first half of 2026, across 1,145 registered cases, and crypto played a part in 70.6 percent of them.

item.title: 100 år gammel lov koster danske kryptoinvestorer millioner. Nu vil minister problemet til livs
item.description: An answer from Danish minister Jakob Engel-Schmidt showed how many Danes pay tax on crypto investments they lost money on, which he called 'actually pretty wild'; he now wants to fix the century-old rule behind it.

item.title: Kollaps for kryptobørs
item.description: Norwegian exchange Firi earned NOK 135 million in 2024 but posted a NOK 44 million loss in the first half of this year.

item.title: Slår et slag for stablecoins
item.description: Valour's Nordic head Johanna Belitz argues stablecoins can make cross-border payments much faster and cheaper.

item.title: Verdiendringer i bitcoin tynger NBX
item.description: NBX made a pre-tax loss of NOK 21.33 million in the first half of 2026, up from NOK 9.85 million a year earlier, with changes in the value of bitcoin weighing on the result.

item.title: Regjeringen utreder midlertidig forbud mot nye kryptodatasentre (skriftlig spørsmål 15:3707)
item.description: A written question in the Storting asks when the government will present its planned state planning provision to limit crypto mining, and why it has concluded the EEA Agreement rules out a general mining ban.

item.title: NBX mer enn doblet tapet i halvåret da MiCA-lisensen kom
item.description: NBX won its MiCA licence in the first half of 2026, but revenue fell 45 percent and its after-tax loss grew to NOK 16.6 million.

item.title: Norway Wants to Ban Bitcoin Mining. The Miners Already Left | Rachel Geyer, EBEA
item.description: In a talk for Bitcoinpolitisk Institutt in Oslo, Rachel Geyer of the European Bitcoin Energy Association argues Norway's proposed mining ban targets a problem the country doesn't have.

item.title: GreenMerc trekker MiCA-klage og bruker Northcryptos lisens i Sverige
item.description: GreenMerc has dropped its MiCA appeal for Ijort Invest and will serve Swedish Trijo customers under Finnish Northcrypto's licence.

item.title: To tilsyn vil ikke si om kryptodistribusjon krever egen tillatelse
item.description: Neither ESMA nor Sweden's Finansinspektionen will say whether distributing crypto services under your own brand needs its own MiCA licence.

item.title: NBX registrert som MoneyGram-agent (børsmelding, engelsk)
item.description: Norwegian Block Exchange (NBX), listed on Euronext Growth Oslo, has been registered as an agent for MoneyGram International.

item.title: DNB tester tokeniserte innskudd i kroner med europeiske banker
item.description: DNB has joined CBMT, where European banks test tokenised bank deposits, adding the Norwegian krone to the test environment.

item.title: Firi tar opp kampen om 1,1 millioner svenske kryptoeiere
item.description: Firi launches in Sweden this week, entering a market where about 1.1 million people already own crypto.

item.title: Hilbert finansierer utlån med innskudd på blokkjeden
item.description: Hilbert Finance is taking stablecoin deposits on-chain and lending them out through a partnership with Ember Protocol.

item.title: Kvarn avviser at Goobit-avtalen er agentforhold eller outsourcing
item.description: Kvarn Capital argues its partnership with Sweden's Goobit falls outside MiCA's ban on agents and its outsourcing rules.

item.title: Firi lanserer i Sverige – etter permitteringer og milliontap
item.description: Crypto exchange Firi lost NOK 43.6 million in the first half of 2026 after weaker trading and high MiCA costs, and has made layoffs while launching in Sweden.

item.title: Finske Kvarn leier ut MiCA-tillatelsen sin til nordiske partnere
item.description: Finland's Kvarn Capital lets Nordic companies sell crypto services under its MiCA licence, with Goobit as the first named client.
